summary.text: Lex Goff is an independent candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 80 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Bill Rhiley.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his priorities include agriculture, infrastructure and tax relief.

paragraphs.text: Lex Goff earned a high school diploma from Wellington High School, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a laborer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has a farm background and is connected with local farmers.
Goff said in the survey that his goals include working with both parties, legislation to expand state infrastructure coverage, and a cap on property tax increases.
He also said he supports marijuana legalization and opposes surveillance that goes against personal privacy.
